# Noto Sans

Static Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic faces from the Noto Fonts project's official
repository at `ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac`:

`https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac/hinted/ttf/NotoSans`

The embedded family is registered as `Noto Sans` at weights 400, 600, and 700.
These files are upstream static faces and have not been modified. `OFL.txt` is
the repository's SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice.
